provenance: Authored synthetic language coverage, 2026-11-01. Questions and closed-world labels fixed before retrieval measurement; no independent human-query or production claim. Memory labels describe retained design constraints, not proof of implemented behavior.

memories.title: Wire sequence agreement
memories.body: Downstream consumers require a stable field sequence in delivery envelopes.

memories.title: Sender cancellation contract
memories.body: Repeated cancellation must be harmless for every operation on this sender.

memories.title: Peer expiration window
memories.body: The peer discards pending deliveries after forty-five seconds. A longer pause loses the notification.

memories.title: Health sampling schedule
memories.body: Sample diagnostic probes once per thousand successful requests.

memories.title: Text transport compatibility
memories.body: Legacy text consumers require the original character encoding.

queries.question: Which constraints must a change to JsonSender.send preserve?
queries.rationale: Preserve the method contract, its enclosing sender contract and the dependency lifetime; health probes and the alternate sender are unrelated.

queries.question: Why does JsonSender.send cap the waiting interval at forty-five seconds?
queries.rationale: The peer lifetime explains the bound. Ordering and cancellation do not explain the interval.

queries.question: What cancellation contract governs JsonSender?
queries.rationale: Only the owner contract specifies cancellation behavior.

queries.question: Which constraints apply to `send` in this project?
queries.rationale: Both implementations are in scope; include the sender owner and timing dependency, but not the unrelated health method.

queries.question: What is the wire sequence agreement?
queries.rationale: Only the field-order agreement answers this focused prose request.

queries.question: Which encryption key rotation interval is required by JsonSender.send?
queries.rationale: No code or memory specifies an encryption key rotation policy.

queries.question: What does retryDelay(2) return?
queries.rationale: The current arithmetic supplies the result without historical decisions.
